svg.title: Workflow: Order-to-cash SaaS support PoC
svg.desc: Solution workflow (conversational) for Order-to-cash SaaS support PoC: 1 trigger: User opens the embedded chat widget with a verified identity (user and tenant) → session; 2 user: Asks a product, how-to or account question → request; 3 agent: Answers from help articles, approved Q&A and SOPs, giving name, path and button label → answer; 4 decision: Account-specific issue? yes → step 5 / no → step 8; 5 guardrail: Tenant taken from verified identity only; any user-supplied tenant or customer ID is ignored → isolated scope; 6 skill: Runs read-only diagnosis queries (customer lookup, pool status, collectible status, ranking filter) → reasons; 7 agent: Explains each reason then the fix → explained answer; 8 decision: User confirms it helped? yes → close without ticket / no → step 9; 9 human: User confirms an agent-drafted, categorized summary; ticket is created and linked to the conversation; support reviews per tier → categorized ticket; 10 outcome: Fewer avoidable tickets and cleaner handoffs (pilot to measure) → lower support load
